SS-WIDGET-RUNTIME.Purpose: Common UI runtime: the Widget contract, instances, reconciliation, signal/layout/render pipeline, inherited context, 2D transforms, clipping, input dispatch and focus.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Widget declarations, lifecycle and input/render hooks, including the explicit ChildrenGuiSpace native-context contract.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: WidgetTree and WidgetEngine: keyed instances, signals, reconciliation, layout and ordered rendering.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Published WidgetGeometrySnapshot, builder and read-only TransformService coordinate queries.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: ClipService read-only local and ancestor clipping queries over the published snapshot.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Flexbox calculation details — owned by SS-FLEXBOX.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Concrete widgets and surface painting — owned by SS-WIDGET-LIBRARY.

Principles.PRIN-001: Definitions and instances are distinct; only the engine modifies the instance tree.
Principles.PRIN-002: Pointer hit testing uses the geometry and clip snapshots retained from the previous ProcessUI call.
Principles.PRIN-003: WidgetRenderer owns render orchestration and GUI.matrix scopes; widgets provide native child-context hooks without concrete-type checks.

Requirements.REQ-001: Matched keys retain instance identity across reconciliation; removed widgets release lifecycle resources and subscriptions.
Requirements.REQ-002: InheritedContextManager uses generated Widget._Update{Prop}FromAncestor to update consumers.
Requirements.REQ-003: Active engines are keyed and discoverable through EngineRegistry.
Requirements.REQ-004: The engine publishes geometry after signals/layout; native child-transform changes request another publication before rendering descendants.
Requirements.REQ-005: Paint order is increasing sibling ZIndex with stable ties; hit testing examines the reverse order.
